aspirational_standard: Fields Medal caliber is an aspirational rubric, not an award claim.

dimensions.justification: Typed primitive objects and notation are present.
The repository claims a reproducible combination, not a new algebraic identity.
Finite algebraic expansions are useful but modest in scope.
Key assumptions are explicit; broad necessity sweeps remain open.
The stated finite theorems have proofs; open bridges are marked.
Snapping and curvature counterexamples are included.
The object-to-certificate chain is coherent.
Unit and symbolic gates pass in the local environment.
Dtype, seed, scaling, and condition indicators are recorded.
Random/PCA/incompatible controls are registered.
Run artifacts, hashes, inventories, and scripts are generated.
Novelty language is conservative.
Initial documentation is concise and extensible.
Conventions are named and separated.
Deterministic publication figures are generated; external review remains useful.
The first slice opens questions rather than resolving them.
Unproved bridges and empirical status are explicit.
Certificates follow the requested contract.
Repository documentation does not rely on prior conversation.
Ready for a reproducible initial release, not a claim of final research completeness.
